notes.title: Multiplayer update 2.0
notes.content:
Hello again!

I know it's only been a few days since the last update, but I have exciting news!

In this update you will finally be able to play the DLC map in multiplayer and with 60 players no less.

There have been some other small fixes as well, like that stat system is now working correctly and there has been some changes to make the beginning of the main map a bit easier. All changes are listed down below.

[list]
[*] DLC map can now be selected in multiplayer
[*] the first part of the main map has been improved and made a bit easier
[*] 2 new achievements for winning in multiplayer
[*] Improved performance, water material should now be less expensive
[*] Stats are now working in game (again)
[/list]

That's all for now, cheers!

notes.title: Just Arms Multiplayer Update
notes.content:
It's been a while since Just Arms got any updates, but today that changes.

In this patch the multiplayer system has been completely reworked. The old one was buggy and did not work properly. Some obstacles weren't replicated correctly, which could break the game in multiplayer.

Additional to multiplayer rework there has also been an engine update and server/client optimization.
Thanks to the rewritten multiplayer code the game now supports up to 60 players per game!

That's not all, see below for a complete list of fixes!

[list]
[*] Engine update
[*] Reworked multiplayer and net replication
[*] Added support for 60 players
[*] Client based physics (this should remove all input latency for clients)
[*] Unlocked skins now work in multiplayer
[*] Players now show name-tags above their characters in multiplayer
[*] Added more sounds so the level doesn't feel so empty
[*] Fixed issue where VR would load if a VR headset is connected.
[/list]

Next patch will add the ability to play the DLC map in multiplayer, so stay tune!

That's all for now, enjoy!
Cheers!

ICEHELM

notes.title: FREE DLC INCOMING
notes.content:
[h2]I have some exciting news![/h2]
The reception for Just Arms have been great so why stop there?
There reason why it's been so quiet here is because there is a free DLC being worked on.

That's right, 100% free content for everyone owning Just Arms.
This new content will include a completely new map with 3 new biomes, new achievements and new skins.

The estimated time of arrival of this DLC is not set yet but expect it to be soon.

notes.title: Release Patch 1.1.0
notes.content:
I would first like to thank everyone who has been playing and streaming Just Arms.
It has been a real joy seeing so much frustration and the pure happiness of those who managed to get to the top.

However, there has been some major issues that need to be corrected.
Down below are some of the most important fixes and changes.

[b]Additions[/b]
[list]
[*] Added zoom out button. A lot of people had trouble seeing a head, which made it hard to predict or strategize their next move. A toggle zoom out has been added to correct this issue.
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] The player no longer collides with each other in multiplayer, this seemed to cause a lot of frustration and unexpected behavior from the player models.
[*] The part with the rolling rocks has been changed, it was far too unforgiving before and some rocks obscured the players view, this was not intended.
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a major bug where the main menu would appear when you finish the game in single player mode.
[*] Fixed a major bug when the game would be softlocked in a menuless state if you went from the main menu to host and then back again.
[*] Players should no longer experience "day/night" cycles in multiplayer.
[*] Multiplayer should now show the correct name of the winner and not the server host.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch v0.2.0 - pre-release patch
notes.content:
I would like to start with an apology.

It was meant for Just Arms to have a new update every weekend, but sadly that timeframe couldn't be kept and for that I am sorry. We live in a strange time with COVID-19 affecting us all.

However, not everything is gloom and doom, for today we release the an update that makes Just Arms a complete game.

You can now play the game from the start to end with all achievements and skins available.

Just Arms is very close to leaving early access and will probably get a full release within the coming weeks.

[b]Additions[/b]
[list]
[*] Added the last sections of the game "Haunted graveyard" and "The Castle"
[*] Added Japanese translation
[*] Added new dialog for NPCs
[*] Added new NPC "The Nun"
[*] Added new skins
[*] Added new achievements
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] All selections of the game has been tweaked, some are easier and others are harder
[*] Changed NPCs dialog 
[/list]

I hope you all have a happy easter despite current circumstances.
Frozen Helm
